summary: Quote on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX, instrument 26000 on segment 1): a 1501 event with its quote at the message root becomes an index Quote frame with open, high, low and the previous close.

notes: An index frame carries no trade-size or book fields (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote).

No recorded 1501-json-full settles where its quote sits: the desktop's XTS fixtures are built, not captured (tests/fixtures/brokers/fivepaisaxts/stream.json quote_1501), the template web adapter reads 1501 at the root ('data is at root level', ibulls_adapter.py:775), and RMoney's reads Touchline when present ('Some payloads embed quote fields under Touchline, others send flat keys', rmoney_adapter.py:901, and its 1501 fallback looks in Touchline, :841-845). The case pins both shapes; a live capture of a 1501-json-full decides which the template's zeros come from.

deviations.reason: An index has no average_price; the web sends XTS's 0 for it, the desktop's index frames leave the trade-size and book fields out (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote; lead decision, night of 9 Nov: web zeros for values an index stream does not have are left out).

An index has no last_quantity; the web sends XTS's 0 for it, the desktop's index frames leave the trade-size and book fields out (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote; lead decision, night of 9 Nov: web zeros for values an index stream does not have are left out).

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST): a wrong unit, since feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in milliseconds (1794199530000).

An index has no total_buy_quantity; the web sends XTS's 0 for it, the desktop's index frames leave the trade-size and book fields out (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote; lead decision, night of 9 Nov: web zeros for values an index stream does not have are left out).

An index has no total_sell_quantity; the web sends XTS's 0 for it, the desktop's index frames leave the trade-size and book fields out (feed/protocol/market.rs shown_quote; lead decision, night of 9 Nov: web zeros for values an index stream does not have are left out).
